about: SHA-256 shows a file is unchanged since this manifest was written. It does not show the file was fetched correctly; the provenance fields say where each file came from.

files.source: Ethereum mainnet: calls and block headers from an archive node (endpoint not recorded), logs through the Etherscan API v2 (only on-chain fields kept); GitHub API and raw.githubusercontent.com for the adapter and its pull requests
files.notes: Every call and log query is pinned to a block, so live_verify.py --check repeats the read against any Ethereum archive endpoint and compares.
